source_fact.paper: Koana and Wahlstrom, Faster Algorithms on Linear Delta-Matroids, STACS 2025
source_fact.use: Every projected linear delta-matroid can be represented as an elementary projection. Therefore non-representability may be tested against one hidden element applied to a linear delta-matroid representation, with visible twist handled explicitly.

local_relation.meaning: The five allowed witness subsets for one mixed degree-3 2-vs-1 Boolean switch.

theorem.name: RANK3_SWITCH_RELATION_IS_NOT_PROJECTED_LINEAR_OVER_ANY_FIELD
theorem.statement: R is not a projected linear delta-matroid over any field.
proof: By the elementary-projection theorem it is enough to consider a linear delta-matroid on visible {L,M,R} plus one hidden h, represented (up to twist) by a skew-symmetric 4x4 matrix A, and existentially project h.

Twisting by h is invisible after existential projection. A visible twist T commutes with projection. Because the untwisted projected family always contains the empty set, R triangle T must contain empty, hence T must itself belong to R. There are only five cases T in {empty,L,M,R,LR}.

For an untwisted skew representation, singleton i is projected-feasible iff a_ih is nonzero; pair ij is feasible iff a_ij is nonzero; triple LMR is feasible iff Pf(A)=a_LM a_Rh - a_LR a_Mh + a_Lh a_MR is nonzero.
T=empty: all three h-edges are nonzero, only visible pair LR is nonzero, while triple is required infeasible. Then Pf(A)=-a_LR a_Mh is nonzero, contradiction.
T=L: h-edges Lh,Rh nonzero and Mh=0; visible pairs LM,LR nonzero and MR=0; triple required infeasible. Then Pf(A)=a_LM a_Rh is nonzero, contradiction.
T=M: only h-edge Mh is nonzero; visible pairs LM,MR nonzero and LR=0; triple required feasible. Every Pfaffian term is zero, contradiction.
T=R: h-edges Lh,Rh nonzero and Mh=0; visible pairs LR,MR nonzero and LM=0; triple required infeasible. Then Pf(A)=a_Lh a_MR is nonzero, contradiction.
T=LR: h-edges Lh,Rh nonzero and Mh=0; only visible pair LR nonzero; triple required feasible. Every Pfaffian term is zero, contradiction.
Each contradiction uses only zero versus nonzero products, so it is valid in every characteristic. Thus no elementary projection exists, and therefore R is not projected linear.

killed: Merge each rank-3 variable switch into one projected-linear delta-matroid relation and invoke the polynomial intersection machinery for two projected linear delta-matroids
A one-hidden skew/Pfaffian representation of the five-state switch over any field
algorithmic_consequence.important_context: Koana-Wahlstrom give randomized polynomial algorithms for intersection of two projected linear delta-matroids. This theorem explains why applying that result directly to the current SAT carrier would require a false local representation claim.
not_killed: Intersection/decomposition using two projected-linear pieces per variable plus additional global structure
Auxiliary constructions that are not projected-linear delta-matroids
